title: Two ScriptHookV-dependent mods conflicting over the same hook
description: Placeholder example rule for the initial known-fix library (see the project's design doc §六 for the intended contribution model: rules land here via reviewed GitHub PRs, not runtime auto-generation). This rule intentionally targets a fixed mod id and exists to prove the ApplyKnownFix -> Plan expansion path end-to-end, not as production-ready guidance — a real rule needs a real, verified crash signature and a mod id resolved from the user's own install, neither of which this project has yet.
